sample_review.method: single ChatGPT model; text-only blind first pass; NOT a truly separate independent model

exploratory_similarity.method: word and bigram TF-IDF cosine; not semantic E5

qualitative_risks: Many new examples share museum/archive, contracting, privacy and licensing premises. Topic and scenario diversity remain unverified.
One-model sample review is not independent review of producer outputs.
Precise topic/domain relevance must be judged from content, not merely metadata or occurrence of 'missile'.
Existing 3,600 externally imported production rows had no independent content QA, which does not imply these candidates are reviewed.
outstanding_gates: Run the repository's exact validate_rows/validate_document_form and `python -m sentinel_dataset prepare` in a Python environment with the E5 model.
Inspect and independently adjudicate the actual E5 high-risk pairs, without rubber-stamping.
Perform genuine separate-model blind review for classification, domain, and relevance; reject and replace any uncertain or low-quality row.
Run checkpoint from a clean, up-to-date production branch, verify output and only then push.
